dataTypes.name: Heart Rate and HRV
dataTypes.description: Heart rate and heart rate variability derived from the PPG sensor.

dataTypes.name: Wrist Movement and Sleep Staging
dataTypes.description: Triaxial accelerometry used to classify sleep and wake periods.
dataTypes.purpose: Estimate sleep staging and body movement.

dataTypes.name: Skin Temperature
dataTypes.description: Wrist skin temperature recorded every five minutes.

dataTypes.name: Electrodermal Activity
dataTypes.description: Skin conductance as a proxy for autonomic arousal.
dataTypes.purpose: Detect sympathetic nervous system activity during sleep.

dataTypes.name: Daily Check-in
dataTypes.description: A short questionnaire in the app, about once a day: how you feel, your mood and your sleep.
dataTypes.purpose: Relate how you feel to your measured sleep.

dataTypes.name: Symptom Log
dataTypes.description: Symptoms you log yourself in the app (which symptom, how strong, optional notes), whenever they start.
dataTypes.purpose: Relate symptoms to your measured sleep and heart rate.
